rows.note: Use this for the all-purpose idea of physically obstructing a route or opening so nothing can pass.

example.english: The car is parked at the entrance to block people from getting in and out.
example.traditional: 架車泊喺門口，阻住人哋出入。
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 bok6 hai2 mun4 hau2 zo2 zyu6 jan4 dei6 ceot1 jap6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a substantial cuboid or block-shaped solid piece.

example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 fong1 faai3 gei2 cung5 wo3

rows.note: Use this for a deliberate obstruction such as a road closure or for blocking access to an account or service.

example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 fung1 so2 zo2 tiu4 lou6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for preventing an action, plan, or event from happening.

example.english: We must block this fight from happening.
example.traditional: 我哋一定要阻止呢場打鬥。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zo2 zi2 ni1 coeng4 daa2 dau3

rows.note: Use this for blocking a person, account, or service from online access or communication.

example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 fung1 so2 go2 go3 zoeng3 wu6

rows.note: Use this for a defined section or logical unit of text, data, land, or similar material.

example.traditional: 呢個區塊係用嚟放廣告嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 keoi1 faai3 hai6 jung6 lei4 fong3 gwong2 gou3 ge3

rows.note: Use this for a block-sized building, especially a block of flats or an office block.

example.english: That block is thirty storeys high.
example.jyutping: go2 zo6 daai6 haa6 jau5 saam1 sap6 cang4 gou1

rows.note: Use this in sports when a player physically gets in the way of an opponent or shot.

example.english: Our defender uses his body to block the opponent's shot.
example.traditional: 我哋個後衛用身體擋住對方嘅射門。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 go3 hau6 wai6 jung6 san1 tai2 dong2 zyu6 deoi3 fong1 ge3 se6 mun4
